thread:
maria: Deploy-bot is recommending an auto-revert after canary p50 breach. Do we let it or suppress for manual review?

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATIC] Canary p50 > 350ms (current p50=415ms) for 7m. Suggested action: auto-revert to v2.13.9 unless suppressed. tag: latency_regression

kevin: Note: Dedicated pools are pinned to v2.14.0 for a customer; hosted would be affected only. We should not trigger infra-wide auto reverts without manual confirmation.

jess: Seeing increased 502s from edge in us-west too. Might be kvcache hotpath.

maria: @kevin how do we suppress the auto-revert? Also need comms copy and release-notes update if we hold.

deploy-bot: To suppress: `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true`. Manual rollback command: `rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted --reason="latency spike"`

kevin: Holding now. `rdwctl release hold --id=rel_2026_04_09 --suppress-auto-revert true` -> OK

sam: Opening SRE bridge to validate KV cache flags and prepare rollback steps.

support-oncall: Drafted customer note: "We're investigating a latency increase observed in canary for the hosted API. Dedicated/pinned instances are unaffected. Update in 30m." Approve to send?

jess: Approve. Also add to release notes: `Known issue: transient kvcache invalidation may elevate p50; workaround: restart worker pool`

kevin: Proposed thresholds: error rate >1% for 10m OR p50 >400ms for 10m -> manual revert to 2.13.9. Otherwise investigate with suppress flag. Agree?

maria: Agreed. I'll monitor and call rollback if thresholds hit, tagging @kevin.

sam: Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/xyz

maria: Update: p50 trending down to 365ms, errors 0.5%. Holding for 20m.

deploy-bot: [NOTE] rollout annotation `suppress_autorevert=true` set by kevin at 2026-04-09T15:12Z

maria: Action items: support sends memo, kevin stays on-call to execute rollback if needed, jess updates release notes. I'll post a final update in 15m.

kevin: Standby to execute `rdwctl rollback --to-version=2.13.9 --scope=hosted` if pinged.

maria: Final: metrics stabilized, no rollback. Releasing hold in 30m and publishing release notes note. Closing.
